children: Crypto gambling platform Duelbits has taken its website offline after attackers stole about $7 million from its hot wallet. Its co-founder Joe said on X that the company had confirmed a hack involving about $7 million and was still investigating the incident and how it was carried out. According to PANews, Duelbits will remain offline until the situation is clarified. Joe said user funds are safe and listed the next steps as completing the investigation, replenishing the hot wallet, resuming Duelbits operations, and launching Duelbits 2.0.

title: Crypto Gambling Platform Duelbits Goes Offline After $7 Million Hot Wallet Hack
